summary: The Web Speech API gained continuous recognition and more accurate utterance boundaries, including final results, silence handling, spacing, and non-bubbling result and error events. Firefox also improved its on-device speech recognition measurement by tracking latency, inference cost, initialization failures, and usage with Glean, while profiling the real recognition threads. Language and locale handling was aligned more closely with the API and Chrome, including the `addFromUri` spelling and Norwegian model selection.
